review.analysis: SFMC-REQ-009 specifies software behavior for the SFMC when remaining fuel falls below 5 percent of usable fuel capacity (displaying a critical-fuel warning and generating an audible alarm). The subject, trigger condition, quantitative threshold (5%), and output actions are explicit and testable. Warning/alarm display does not constitute a safety control (inhibit, interlock, or automated safe state transition) under SWE-184 guidance, so swe_links remains empty. No defects found.
review.summary: SFMC-REQ-009 is an acceptable, testable functional requirement with clear quantitative thresholds and unambiguous software output obligations.
